pseudo_code.calculate_commission:
function calculate_commission(buyer_type, block, floor_level, unit_type, unit_category, sale_price):
    commission_rate = 0

    IF buyer_type == 'foreign' AND block == 'B' AND unit_type NOT IN ['GB1', 'GB2']:
        commission_rate = 7%
        # Commission calculated on net price after discount and after deducting RM200k for furnishing
    ELSE IF buyer_type == 'local':
        IF block == 'A':
            commission_rate = 2%
        ELSE IF block == 'B':
            IF unit_category IN ['Garden Unit', 'Penthouse']:
                commission_rate = 7%
            ELSE IF floor_level >= 11 AND floor_level <= 19:
                commission_rate = 6%
            ELSE IF floor_level >= 20 AND floor_level <= 29:
                commission_rate = 5%
            ELSE IF floor_level >= 30 AND floor_level <= 38:
                commission_rate = 4%
    RETURN commission_rate
pseudo_code.calculate_rebate:
function calculate_rebate(buyer_type, unit_type, block, floor_level, purchase_mode, is_bumi):
    rebate_total = 0

    IF is_bumi:
        rebate_total += 5%

    IF unit_type == 'A1':
        rebate_total += 9%
    ELSE IF unit_type == 'A2':
        rebate_total += 6%

    IF block == 'B':
        IF floor_level >= 1 AND floor_level <= 19:
            rebate_total += 7%
        ELSE IF floor_level >= 20 AND floor_level <= 29:
            rebate_total += 7%
        ELSE IF floor_level >= 30:
            rebate_total += 6%

    IF unit_type IN ['OB1', 'OB2']:
        rebate_total += 10%

    IF purchase_mode == 'loan':
        rebate_total += 7%

    # Additional rebate budgets
    IF unit_type IN ['E', 'B2']:
        rebate_total += 1.4%

    RETURN rebate_total
pseudo_code.calculate_final_price:
function calculate_final_price(base_price, floor_level, car_park_choice, buyer_type, block, unit_type, purchase_mode, is_bumi):
    adjusted_price = base_price

    # Floor premium adjustments
    IF floor_level < 20:
        adjusted_price += floor_level * 3000
    ELSE IF floor_level == 20:
        adjusted_price += 50000
    ELSE IF floor_level == 30:
        adjusted_price += 30000

    # Car park premium adjustments
    IF car_park_choice == 'tandem':
        adjusted_price += 50000
    ELSE IF car_park_choice == 'single':
        adjusted_price += 50000

    # Foreign package adjustment
    IF buyer_type == 'foreign' AND block == 'B' AND unit_type NOT IN ['GB1', 'GB2']:
        adjusted_price += adjusted_price * 0.04 + 200000

    rebate_total = calculate_rebate(buyer_type, unit_type, block, floor_level, purchase_mode, is_bumi)
    final_price = adjusted_price * (1 - rebate_total / 100)
    RETURN final_price
